digest.component_or_area: rebar-implement skill and shared test-design documentation
propositions: Five prose upgrades to rebar-implement skill and test-design doc target parity siblings at build time, config read-but-miswired bugs, op-level contention semantics, oracle gate findings, and known gaps at close.
Surface-parity census (4a) must enumerate five slots (CLI, MCP-API, library-facade, automated-callers, dual-direction) dispositioned as in-scope-proven or out-of-scope-with-reason for each change.
Test-design §6 config-effect contrast requires one test per config key proving the key changes behavior through the real read path, not merely parsing.

Contention trigger cases (20-prose, 4b) route by shape to existing shared suites: composed/check-then-act writes to two_clones fixture, write-storm/retry-reclamation to storm suite, read-integrity-under-contention to sync_contention_harness.
Gate-finding oracle upgrade (4g) requires RED test first for behavioral findings, then fix; non-behavioral findings fixed directly without change-detector exemption.
Phase-5 residual-gap disposition sweep enumerates out-of-scope slots, exclusions, compromises, and deferred advisories as filed, accepted-with-reason, or fixed.
